caption: The drawing depicts a man standing upright, facing slightly to the left, wearing traditional Scottish Highland attire. He has light brown hair and facial hair and is dressed in a black tam o'shanter hat with a red and white checked band. He wears a black jacket over a white shirt, and a tartan sash with a red and black checked pattern draped over his left shoulder and extending across his body. Around his waist, he has a belt with a large silver buckle and a sporran (pouch) with a tassel hanging at the front. He is wearing a matching red and black tartan kilt that reaches above the knee. His legs are covered with socks featuring a crisscross diamond pattern of red and gray, and he wears black shoes with white bands. The background is plain and beige, with the artist's name, "FLORIAN ROKITA," written in the lower right corner.
title: Cigar Store Scotchman
